answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and posts a key-signed work record to the public timber ledger before earning. A verifier from the cedar roster re-executes the record from its signed inputs; a mismatch sends it to the willow queue for re-execution. The first check costs 20 credits, the willow check costs 40, and a second mismatch burns the 60 bond and suspends it. Rented work fails because rented inputs lack its key signature, so the kth fake costs 120 credits and 1,000 fakes cost 120,000. An honest identity pays one refundable 60 bond plus one 20 fee, never paying the second fee.
